newsitem.title: USA: Investor has Primex Technologies stake.
newsitem.headline: Investor has Primex Technologies stake.

text.p: New York investment manager Jeffrey Halis said Tuesday that he and entities he controls have acquired 299,064 shares of Primex Technologies Inc., or 5.7 percent of the total outstanding.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the Halis group said it acquired the shares for investment purposes.
The group said it bought the shares between Jan. 10 and 31 at prices ranging from $17.42 to $19.41 a share.
